## install and load libraries

```{r}
#remotes::install_github("FertigLab/CoGAPS")
library(CoGAPS)
```

## To ensure CoGAPS is working properly, first load in the simulated toy data for a test run #optional

```{r}
#download(testdata from the gihub repo)
modsimdata
head(modsimdata, c(5L, 5L))
dim(modsimdata)
```

## set parameters#optional step

```{r}
# create new parameters object
params <- CogapsParams(nPatterns = 7)
# Get current value
getParam(params, "nPatterns")

params <- setParam(params, "nPatterns", 8)     # start here for plaque
params <- setParam(params, "nIterations", 50000)
params <- setParam(params, "seed", 42)          # for reproducibility
params <- setParam(params, "sparseOptimization", TRUE)  # good for snRNA-seq
```

## Run CoGAPS on the ModSim data #optional step

```{r}
cogapsresult <- CoGAPS(modsimdata, params, outputFrequency = 10000)
```
